why: No news dated the day of the run or later
No value of any field has a tag / list / search page as source
No value has businessinsider.com/sc/ as source
No tag rests on a cookie or privacy sentence
No acquired row rests on a profile page, a blog or a database
No company has two identical rounds
No quote is an address or a slug
No company has more than one description
No company has more than one sector
A round's type is written only when its quote names it (else Unknown)
Every quote is a sentence, not page code
A leader's executive role is in its quote
No founding year rests on a customer / project / partner page
Every value that came from the memory passes this run's rules
A competitor appears once under its clean name (no year, no bracket)
A headquarters city rests on a street address or on a sentence that declares it (<city>-based, headquartered in, head office)
No value rests on a sponsored / brand-studio / patrocinado path
No news or round rests on a yahoo republication
No value rests on a paid distribution service
No news item is a product review
No tag rests on a job ad or a menu
One purchase is one news item: no two items name the same buyer for the same company with different dates
A founder's name is the name of a person: not the company's own name, not one word, no "Co" alone, no verb of a headline (Buildium: "Buildium Co", "Publishes Lessons")
